newsitem.title: USA: Shanghai Petrochemical sees more write-offs.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petrochemical sees more write-offs.

text.p: Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd on Tuesday said it expected further write-offs of building-use rights for its staff quarters over the next few years, though those actions would not have an adverse material effect on its financial position.
An initial write-off for building-use rights was mentioned in its financial results statement released April 15.
The company said Shanghai municipal regulations require that staff quarters be sold to middle-income and low-income employees at cost value minus certain discounts.
Rights that have been transferred to the staff -- about 80 percent -- were already written off as as an exceptional item.
The company said its remaining building-use rights in the quarters will be gradually sold to staff in the next few years, and their value will be written off accordingly.
The total amount will not exceed 42 million renminbi (Chinese yuan) "and it would not have a material adverse effect on the financial position of the company," Shanghai said.
